name: annotations_b2_pass1
title: Pass-1 span annotations over the b2 corpus (v5 prompt, framing C)
description: glm-5.2-vision framing-C annotations of all 92 b2 plan pairs. 879 flag rows (CYCLE 344, LOOP 504, MUSE 31); 505 resolved to char offsets (57.5%), unresolved rows keep quotes. conf: clear 660, probable 219. 167/184 traces flagged. MUSE per family: assign 12, certify 8, adversary 4, hypothesis 4, machine 2, grid 1 - the batch's purpose was the MUSE gap into new families. Two pairs hit the thinking wall (p117, p142) and used the A-fallback (framing A per trace).
caveats: Two pairs (p117, p142) triggered A-fallback after framing-C hit finish=length with no usable flags; A-framing rows are included. R0 agreement on the double subset: span Jaccard 0.417 (borderline-usable, above xsub's 0.26).
